messages:
kevin: Heads-up — planning to enable polestar-11b-v1 in the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Change window is 10:00–11:00 UTC. Need fallback ordering, pin strategy, and rollback thresholds.

sarah: +1. What's the canary size?

kevin: Start with 3% traffic canary for 20m, then 15% for 30m, then 100% if no regressions. Canary region: us-west1.

anna: Ops: confirm capacity on dedicated pools? We need GPUs reserved in us-west1 for the canary.

ops-oncall: Confirmed — reserved 4 nodes in dedicated-pool-west. Autoscaler will allow burst to 6 nodes if latency stays under SLO.

lucas: For fallback ordering, propose: 1) polestar-11b-quant (fastest, lower cost), 2) polestar-11b-v1 (full float), 3) legacy-11b (current default). If polestar-v1 fails, fallback to legacy so we don't impact downstream A/B.

maria: Suggest pin list for enterprise customers: pin high-volume tenants to legacy-11b for first 48h, then reconcile. Also add a hard pin threshold if error_rate > 1% for a tenant.

kevin: Agreed. Draft config I plan to push to the catalog canary:

```json
{
  "model": "catalog:polestar-11b-v1",
  "canary": {"initial_pct": 3, "stages": [{"pct":15, "duration_mins":30}]},
  "fallback_order": ["catalog:polestar-11b-quant","catalog:polestar-11b-v1","catalog:legacy-11b"],
  "pin_policy": {"enterprise_protected": true, "auto_reconcile_after_hours":48}
}
```

sarah: Rollback triggers? We should be explicit: latency regressed p50 > 30% from baseline or error_rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m. Also alert on model rejection spike (>0.5% increase).

kevin: Proposed rollback signal set: p50 > 30% OR p95 > 20% OR error_rate > 0.8% for 5m. If triggered during canary, auto-drain canary and pin back to legacy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: catalog-canary polestar-11b-v1 -> start 1768591200 (2026-03-18T10:00:00Z). Notified: @kevin @sarah @anna @ops-oncall

maria: Add a grace window for traffic shaping: if we see a transient spike during first 5m, tolerant until 2 consecutive 1m windows exceed thresholds. Avoid noisy auto rollback.

kevin: Good point. Update: require 5m sustained for error_rate and p50/p95 conditions; for single-minute spikes hold off.

lucas: Observability checklist: add a per-model route dashboard, latency heatmap, token-level cost delta, and soft alerts to #eng-oncall with escalation to #eng-sre on critical.

ops-oncall: I'll create the monitoring runbook and route filters. Will also add a traffic snapshot job to capture samples every 60s during the rollout.

anna: Release notes needed for platform and customers. Key bullets: polestar-11b-v1 enabled (better coherence on long contexts), fallback ordering, enterprise pin policy, canary schedule, rollback thresholds, cost impact estimate (~+12% token cost for float variant).

kevin: I'll draft release notes and post to product/changelog before 07:00 UTC tomorrow. @maria can you validate wording for enterprise comms?

maria: Yep — will review by 08:30 UTC.

sarah: One more operational thing: make sure the routing policy includes region-aware fallback so EU traffic doesn't get routed to us-west fallback unless allowed. Add region_exempt list.

kevin: Noted — will include region_exempt: [eu-west1, eu-central1] in the policy for first 24h.

deploy-bot: Canary preflight checks passed: model artifact checksum OK, quant artifact present, memory footprint within limits.

ops-oncall: Quick runbook excerpt: if rollback triggers, run: 
1) deploy-bot cancel canary 1768591200
2) catalog pin add catalog:legacy-11b --scope global --reason "polestar rollback"
3) notify @eng-sre and @product

kevin: Everyone OK with plan? Reply with :thumbsup: to approve or raise concerns.

sarah: :thumbsup:

anna: :thumbsup:

lucas: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: :thumbsup:

kevin: Great — moving forward. I'll post the release notes and trigger the scheduled deploy. Will keep this thread updated during the window.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: catalog-canary polestar-11b-v1 (id: cb-20260318-001) -> 3% -> 15% -> monitor. Logs will stream to #eng-releases-canary.

kevin: Adding final note: after 24h of stable traffic we'll open the pin reconciliation ticket to move enterprise tenants onto polestar where approved.

maria: I'll own the reconciliation ticket.

kevin: Thanks all — closing thread until deploy starts.
